apple_crate.look: a simple wooden CRATE seen FLAT and FACE-ON (straight from the front, NOT angled, NOT tilted, NOT isometric): a square slatted wooden box with a few red APPLES piled on top. Mostly just a plain front-facing wooden crate.

autonet.look: an AUTONET automatic fly-catcher seen front-on, WIDER than tall: on the left a round spinning electric FAN in a housing, and ATTACHED right beside it a cylindrical metal TANK/vat with a mesh intake; the fan sucks flies through the opening into a collection net inside the tank. A quirky two-part bug-suction machine on little legs.

bait_basket.look: a small round WICKER BASKET of fishing bait — woven tan straw sides, a few worms/grubs poking over the rim; NOT a trash bin

chest_wood.look: a closed wooden treasure CHEST: a rectangular wooden box with a rounded hinged LID, dark iron METAL BANDS and a metal latch/lock on the front.

chopping_block.look: a round WOOD CHOPPING BLOCK (a short log section) with a steel AXE embedded in the top and a few wood chips at its base; NOT a whole tree

collection_tray.look: a shallow rectangular WOODEN TRAY on short legs, the top divided into small compartments holding tiny specimens (bugs/minerals); NOT a dining table

compost_bin.look: a wooden COMPOST BIN: an open-topped slatted wooden box filled with dark crumbly compost and food scraps mounded above the rim. Clearly a compost bin, NOT a plain crate.

door_wood.look: a single closed WOODEN DOOR standing in a simple wooden door FRAME: a tall vertical slab made of vertical wood planks, with two or three recessed rectangular PANELS, a small round brass DOORKNOB near the right edge at mid-height, and a visible frame/jamb around it. It must read instantly as a DOORWAY you could walk through - NOT a cabinet, dresser, box, or wardrobe. Taller than it is wide.

door_square.look: a SIMPLE closed WOODEN DOOR filling a tall narrow doorway, clearly TWO tiles tall and ONE tile wide: a plain slab of vertical wood planks (no recessed panels), with a small dark IRON handle/latch near the right edge at mid-height and a thin wooden frame/jamb around it. Rustic village carpentry. It must read instantly as a DOORWAY you could walk through - NOT a cabinet, crate, dresser, or wardrobe. Distinctly taller than it is wide (a 1-wide, 2-tall slab).

fence_electric.look: a section of ELECTRIC FENCE: a slim post with two horizontal taut WIRES running left and right, small ceramic INSULATORS where the wires meet the post and a tiny warning spark; same post-and-rail layout as a wooden fence but thin metal wire.

fence_iron.look: a section of wrought-IRON FENCE: a slim dark metal POST with two horizontal metal RAILS running left and right off it (same post-and-rail layout as a wooden fence, but dark wrought iron, slimmer).

fence_wood.look: a section of wooden post-and-rail FENCE: a vertical wooden POST with two horizontal RAILS running left and right off it; rustic split wood.

fireplace.look: a STONE FIREPLACE: a chunky grey stone hearth with a dark arched FIREBOX opening in the lower-center, warm glowing ORANGE-AND-YELLOW FLAMES burning inside the opening, and a flat stone MANTEL ledge across the top. Stone surround framing the fire on the left, right and top; the fire is the bright focal point.

fly_netting.look: a square patch of NET hung up: a flat square panel of fine MESH — a simple GRID OF CROSSED STRINGS, slightly slack — with a few small dark FLIES caught on it. Just the open mesh grid, NO wooden frame, NO box, NO solid panel; you can see through the holes.

garden_arch.look: a GARDEN ARCH / trellis archway seen front-on: two slim posts joined by an arched top, with climbing green VINES and small flowers over it and an open walk-through gap in the middle. A decorative garden arch.

gate_wood.look: a wooden fence GATE: a single hinged gate panel matching a wooden fence - a frame of horizontal rails with a diagonal CROSS-BRACE, slightly shorter, meant to sit in a fence line as the openable section.

hedge.look: a section of trimmed HEDGE: a dense flat-topped block of green leafy shrubbery, like a low green wall. The foliage spans the FULL WIDTH and bleeds off the left and right edges so sections tile into one continuous hedge with no gap.

ladder.look: a tall WOODEN LADDER standing upright — two vertical side rails joined by evenly spaced horizontal rungs; NOT a fence, NOT a wall

net_post.look: a bug-catching NET STATION: a tall wooden POST with a round hoop NET of fine pale mesh mounted at the top (a butterfly-style net fixed upright on a stand). Clearly a net on a post.

notice_board.look: a wooden NOTICE BOARD — a framed board on a post with a few pinned PAPER notes; NOT a door, NOT a blank post

signpost.look: a wooden CROSSROADS SIGNPOST seen front-on: a single THIN tall vertical wooden POST, with two or three flat arrow-shaped DIRECTIONAL SIGN-BOARDS nailed near the top pointing left and right, each board WIDER than the slim shaft; weathered grey-brown wood. A tall narrow waymarker, NOT a single wide board.

well.look: a stone WATER WELL: a round waist-high STONE wall (the well shaft), a wooden POST on each side holding a small peaked wooden ROOF over the top, and a bucket on a rope. Dark water in the opening. Reads clearly as a wishing well, NOT a plain hole.

window_4pane.look: a closed GLASS WINDOW set in a wooden frame, seen front-on, filling a tall wall-tile shape: a wooden frame divided by a cross MULLION into FOUR equal glass PANES, the glass pale blue-white with a soft diagonal reflection. Reads instantly as a window in a wall, NOT a painting, cabinet or door. The frame fills the tile; transparent outside it.

wall_marble.look: a section of polished WHITE MARBLE wall block, bright pale cream-white with faint soft grey veining, a clean fitted ashlar face seen front-on; pale, bright and fancy, clearly much LIGHTER than wood or grey stone

column_marble.look: a tall fluted white MARBLE COLUMN with a simple capital and round base, seen front-on; classical, pale, NOT a tree

sign_anchor.look: a hanging wooden SHOP SIGN on a post with a painted blue ANCHOR symbol; a fishing/boat-store sign

sign_anvil.look: a hanging wooden SHOP SIGN on a post with a black ANVIL silhouette painted on it; a blacksmith sign

sign_market.look: a wooden SHOP SIGN board on a post reading MARKET with a painted basket of produce; a market sign

sign_shop.look: a painted wooden SHOP SIGN board on a post with a basket-of-goods icon; a general-store sign

sign_crest.look: a carved heraldic TOWN CREST shield sign on a post, painted with a small coat of arms; a town-hall sign

sign_plank.look: a rough sawn-PLANK SIGN on a post with a hammer-and-saw carpenter icon; a workshop sign

sign_leaf.look: a wooden SHOP SIGN on a post painted with a green LEAF and a small bug; a naturalist/ecologist sign

sign_ant.look: a wooden hanging SHOP SIGN on a post, seen front-on, painted with a large bold black ANT in profile (segmented head-thorax-abdomen, six legs, two antennae) above the word MYRMECOLOGY; a field-research station sign, weathered wood

market_stall.look: an open-air MARKET STALL — a wooden counter under a striped peaked AWNING roof on poles, seen front-on; a trading booth, NOT a tent

awning.look: a striped fabric AWNING projecting out from a shop front, scalloped front edge, seen front-on; a shade canopy strip

produce_crate.look: a wooden produce CRATE COVERED with a tied-down blue PLASTIC TARP roped over the top, the tarp hiding the contents; a couple of apples and a carrot peek from a gap at one corner so you can tell it holds fruit and vegetables. A covered fruit/veg crate.

dock_plank.look: a square section of weathered grey wooden DOCK DECKING, planks running across, seen top-down; a flat pier walkway tile

boat.look: a small wooden ROWBOAT seen from above, pointed bow, two oars across the seats, brown hull; a moored boat, NOT a building

mooring_post.look: a thick wooden MOORING POST / piling rising from water, a rope loop around the top; a dock bollard

fish_crate.look: a wooden CRATE of fresh silver FISH on crushed ice; a fishmonger crate

fishing_net.look: a large fishing NET strung up on a wooden frame to DRY, draped mesh, seen front-on; NOT bug netting

coal_bin.look: an open iron BIN heaped with chunky black COAL beside a forge; a fuel bin

lumber_rack.look: a slanted wooden RACK holding stacked sawn PLANKS and boards, seen front-on; a carpenter's lumber store

bait_station.look: a post-mounted DISH of rotting fruit BAIT under a small peaked roof, a few flies hazing above; a fly attractant station

veg_patch_sign.look: a small hand-painted wooden garden SIGN on a stake reading a vegetable name, by a veg patch

broken_fence.look: a BROKEN SPLIT-RAIL FENCE section: a leaning grey weathered wooden post with one cracked, sagging rail, half-buried in grass; dilapidated and abandoned. NOT an intact fence.

sign_market_board.look: a wide 3-panel hanging MARKET sign board mounted across two posts spanning a shopfront, reading MARKET in painted letters with a small basket-of-produce icon; a big HORIZONTAL shop sign, NOT a single narrow signpost

fence_picket.look: a section of white PICKET fence: several evenly-spaced pointed-top vertical white PICKETS joined by two horizontal rails; a tidy painted cottage fence, seen front-on

gate_picket.look: a white PICKET fence GATE: a single hinged picket gate panel with pointed-top slats and a frame, set slightly to swing open, matching a white picket fence line

fence_picket_weathered.look: a section of weathered grey PICKET fence: pointed-top vertical pickets with peeling faded grey-white paint, one or two slats cracked or missing; a run-down cottage fence, seen front-on

sign_fish_board.look: a wide 3-panel hanging wooden FISHING-STORE sign board on two posts, spanning a shopfront; painted with a blue ANCHOR and a silver FISH; weathered seaside paint; a big HORIZONTAL shop sign, NOT a narrow signpost

hay_bale.look: a rolled golden HAY BALE seen front-on: a fat cylinder of tightly rolled straw lying on its side, visible spiral coil on the round face, a few loose straws sticking out; warm golden yellow

standing_stone.look: a single ancient STANDING STONE monolith: one tall weathered grey stone slab set upright in the grass, slightly tapered top, moss patches and faint carved grooves near the base; a lone megalith, NOT a wall, NOT stacked rocks

rowboat_beached.look: a small weathered wooden ROWBOAT seen from above, pulled up on land and resting slightly TILTED to one side: faded sun-bleached planks, no oars, a little sand spilling over the bow; abandoned and beached, NOT floating

sign_weaver.look: a WIDE hanging wooden shop SIGN strung between two short posts, a painted SPOOL OF THREAD with a needle across the board. Clearly wider than tall.

sign_mason.look: a stonemason's wooden SHOP SIGN TWO cells wide: a horizontal carved wooden board hung from a frame, a grey chisel-and-mallet emblem carved on it. A storefront sign seen front-on.

bug_extractor.look: a BUG EXTRACTOR craft station: a squat copper-and-brass apparatus on a wooden bench base — a glass bell jar on top, a small hand-crank on the side, a spigot and collection vial at the front; alchemical workshop feel

fence_stone.look: a section of low STONE WALL fence: stacked rough grey fieldstones with visible mortar joints, a flat capstone course on top (same post-and-rail layout family as the other fences: runs left and right)
